Handle Stripe webhooks (checkout.session.completed, payment_intent.succeeded).

Records transaction + updates balance when Stripe payment completes.

SECURITY:
- Validates Stripe signature before processing
- Uses database UNIQUE constraint on stripe_payment_intent_id
  to prevent race condition double-crediting

Handles:
- checkout.session.completed: When Checkout Session payment succeeds
- payment_intent.succeeded: When direct PaymentIntent succeeds
- payment_intent.payment_failed: Logs failed payments
